It's cold and rainy and chicken soup is delicious. It also has lean meats, whole grains and vegetables. Don't overdo the spices, chicken soup practically flavors itself.

Ingredients:

  • 1/2 lb bloneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed

  • 5-6 cups chicken broth, or water + bullion

  • 3/4 cup long grain brown rice

  • 1 large carrot, thickly sliced

  • 2 celery stalk, thickly sliced

  • 1/2 onion, diced

  • 1/2 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped OR Red Pepper flakes. Optional, if you don't like spicy things.

  • 2-3 cloves garlic, finely chopped

  • 1-2 tsp olive oil

  • 1 pinch each Thyme, Parsley, Basil

  • 1/4 - 1/2 tsp ground Cumin

  • Salt & Pepper to taste

Directions:

heat oil in large heavy bottomed pan over med. You don't need much - just enough to keep the vegetables from sticking until they give up their juices.

Add vegetables, garlic and jalepeno and cook 5-6 minutes, until the onions are tender and the celery is bright

Add spices and cook for another 30 seconds or so

Add 4 cups broth and rice, bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cook for 30-40 minutes or until the rice is almost done

Add extra broth as needed, as the rice will absorb a lot

About 8 minutes before the rice is done, add the cubed chicken and stir to cover the chicken completely. Cook until the chicken is done, about 5-8 minutes.
